column2: A single strong human heartbeat, one deep double thump lub-dub, clean and close, dry, no music, no voice
A short soft clean sonar ping, single bright round beep with a quick fade, dry, no music, no voice
A tall tower of wooden toy blocks toppling over like dominoes and clattering onto a wooden floor, playful cartoon, no voice, no music
A single loud crisp satisfying balloon pop, close, dry, no music, no voice
A short sci-fi laser sword slicing swoosh with a bright electric zap, one single cut, no music, no voice
A safe combination dial clicking three times followed by a heavy metal bolt clunk as the safe door unlocks, satisfying, no music, no voice
A single deep punchy tom drum hit, short, dry, no reverb, no music, no voice
